description: Cancel a booking. This is irreversible: call preview_cancellation, tell the user the penalty and refund, and set confirm to true only after the user explicitly agreed.

bookingId.description: Identifier of one booking inside an order, from get_booking.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user explicitly confirmed this action.

reason.description: Short reason given by the user.
